heading.en: When is a sale really a sale?

hook.en: A furniture shop sells a sofa in March but receives the money in May. In which year is the revenue earned? The next set of concepts decides this.
hook.kn: ಪೀಠೋಪಕರಣ ಅಂಗಡಿ ಮಾರ್ಚ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೋಫಾ ಮಾರಿ ಮೇನಲ್ಲಿ ಹಣ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದಾಯ ಯಾವ ವರ್ಷದ್ದು? ಮುಂದಿನ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆಗಳು ಇದನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

title.en: Revenue recognition, matching and full disclosure

body.en: Revenue recognition: revenue is recorded in the period in which it is earned, that is, when the sale is made or the service is rendered, even if cash comes later. Matching: the expenses incurred to earn that revenue are charged in the same period, so outstanding and prepaid expenses are adjusted. Full disclosure: all material facts must be shown in the financial statements or the notes to them.
body.kn: ಆದಾಯ ಗುರುತಿಸುವಿಕೆ: ಆದಾಯ ಗಳಿಸಿದ ಅವಧಿಯಲ್ಲೇ ದಾಖಲಿಸುವುದು. ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆ: ಅದೇ ಅವಧಿಯ ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳನ್ನು ಆದಾಯದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸುವುದು. ಪೂರ್ಣ ಬಹಿರಂಗ: ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುವುದು.

body.en: Consistency: the same methods are followed year after year; a change is made only for a good reason and is disclosed. Conservatism (prudence): anticipate no profit but provide for all possible losses, so stock is valued at cost or net realisable value, whichever is lower, and a provision is made for doubtful debts. Materiality: only facts that can affect users' decisions need detailed treatment. Objectivity: entries must be supported by verifiable evidence such as vouchers.
body.kn: ಸ್ಥಿರತೆ: ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ಒಂದೇ ವಿಧಾನ. ವಿವೇಕ (ಸಂಪ್ರದಾಯವಾದ): ಸಂಭಾವ್ಯ ನಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೆ ಅವಕಾಶ, ನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿತ ಲಾಭಕ್ಕೆ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಮಹತ್ವ: ಮುಖ್ಯ ವಿಷಯಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ವಿವರ. ವಸ್ತುನಿಷ್ಠತೆ: ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಸಾಕ್ಷ್ಯ.

problem.en: At year end, Deepa Stores has stock costing ₹50,000 whose net realisable value is ₹46,000, and another lot costing ₹30,000 with net realisable value ₹34,000. At what total value will closing stock be shown?

steps.en: Value each lot at the lower of cost and net realisable value.
Lot 2: lower of ₹30,000 and ₹34,000 = ₹30,000; the expected gain of ₹4,000 is not taken.
